email.subject: Quick note on Keel Co Auto Care's site
email.body:
Hi Chloe,

I looked at Keel Co Auto Care's site. Two things are likely costing you customers: there's no way to book an appointment online, so anyone searching after hours just moves to the next shop, and your hours aren't listed anywhere, which makes people unsure if you're even open before they call or drive over.

I also noticed the homepage title doesn't mention Harbor Falls or auto care, which hurts how you show up in local search.

I fix these for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough of what I'd change, no pitch attached.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
